title: senna stricta
intro: Senna stricta, commonly known as black candle bush or sweet broom, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its use as a natural laxative due to its high content of anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation. The therapeutic actions of Senna stricta include its ability to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which make it effective in relieving symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Senna stricta include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
